head: codex/5883-retire-csdlc-init
title: [Backlog][C-SDLC v2] Retire duplicate csdlc-init entrypoint
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5883

Retires the duplicate csdlc-init binary and makes csdlc-issue create the sole typed issue-creation route. Removes it from active installer, coexistence, proof, skill, runbook, adapter, and architecture authority while preserving historical evidence.

Validation: Gate 2 1/1; Gate 10A 19/19; strict all-target Clippy; active command scan; installed adl_pr_cycle skill test; exact-head subagent review with all findings fixed.
